_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-26. src/svc.ts defines searchViaPostgres at line 1 and calls it at line 10. W8's contract is that a finding about the CALL snaps to the call site rather than the definition — the #39 failure mode. Line 2 is allowed because the body of the definition is a legitimate anchor for a finding genuinely about the implementation; line 1, the `export async function` signature, is the one W8 must move off when a use-site exists. One-sided, like E2E-17.
